style_prompt: Editorial-quality flowchart diagram, hand-drawn line work on warm off-white paper background (#F7F4ED). Two-tone palette of deep Alberta navy (#1A3A6E) for primary nodes and rust orange (#C2491A) for accents and arrows. Boxes have subtle shadows; labels in clean sans-serif; arrows are slightly curved with arrowheads. Architectural, calm, technical but human. Wide editorial aspect. No photo realism, no people, no logos, no watermarks. All text labels in English.
image_prompt: An editorial illustration of a large, transparent three-dimensional lattice or cube floating in space, built from thousands of small glowing nodes. Three visible faces each read as a different ordering of the same nodes: one face grouped as business capabilities, one as code repositories, one as technology layers. Fine connecting threads show that any node can be reached from any face. A single dataset seen from three directions at once. Muted Alberta cream palette, navy and rust accents, archival print quality, no text. Labels: «Capacidades de negocio», «Repositorios de código», «Capas tecnológicas». All text labels in es. Match the composition of the source image exactly; only the text labels change.
